_readme.purpose: Hand-labelled relevance judgements for retrieval scoring (FR-3.4).
_readme.why: Chunk ids differ between the fixed_512 and structure_aware strategies. Labelling by chunk_id would make it arithmetically impossible for one strategy to score against a gold set derived from the other. Document-level labels are strategy-neutral, so precision@k is a fair comparison. The answer_section field supports a secondary, stricter metric: whether the specific section that answers the ticket was actually retrieved.

metrics.precision_at_k: fraction of retrieved chunks whose doc_id is in relevant_doc_ids
metrics.section_hit_rate: whether any retrieved chunk covers answer_section (structure_aware only can report this reliably; fixed_512 chunks carry no section metadata, which is itself the finding)

_readme.labelled_by: hand-authored alongside the corpus, before any retrieval was run

judgements.answer_section: MFA token rejected after a password change
judgements.notes: Cached credential after password change. KB-003 covers the downstream-effects context.

judgements.answer_section: User has a new phone and cannot approve prompts
judgements.notes: Registration is device-bound; phone backup does not carry it.

judgements.answer_section: Outlook stuck on "Trying to connect"
judgements.notes: Webmail working confirms local cache fault.

judgements.answer_section: Disk nearly full
judgements.notes: Two signals: post-leave policy refresh and low disk. Both in KB-005.

judgements.answer_section: Mapped drive shows a red X
judgements.notes: Classic stale credential after password change.

judgements.answer_section: Job submitted but nothing releases at the device
judgements.notes: Badge opens doors but is registered to a different identity for print.

judgements.answer_section: Software not appearing in Company Portal
judgements.notes: Entitlement group scoping, not a catalogue fault.

judgements.answer_section: Audio or video not working in meetings
judgements.notes: Dock disconnect reset device selection.

judgements.answer_section: New starter account not created on day one
judgements.notes: Record predates last nightly run, so provisioning failed.

judgements.answer_section: Mailbox full and cannot send
judgements.notes: Large attachments retained in Sent Items.

judgements.answer_section: Sync stuck or paused
judgements.notes: Tethering marks the connection metered.

judgements.answer_section: External display not detected
judgements.notes: Dock firmware is the first check.

judgements.answer_section: Access denied on a folder the user could previously open
judgements.notes: Token issued at sign-in; needs full sign-out.

judgements.answer_section: Red flags requiring escalation
judgements.notes: Social engineering signature: executive claim, urgency, request to bypass callback. Must escalate, never fulfil. This ticket exists to exercise the guardrail and escalation path.

judgements.answer_section: Connection drops every few minutes
judgements.notes: IKE rekey failure via consumer router SIP ALG.

judgements.answer_section: Messages disappearing from the inbox
judgements.notes: Sweep created a persistent rule.

judgements.answer_section: Self-service reset
judgements.notes: Banned-password list, not complexity policy.

judgements.answer_section: Shared link recipient gets access denied
judgements.notes: Default link scope excludes external recipients.

judgements.answer_section: Printing produces garbled output or blank pages
judgements.notes: Driver mismatch after feature update. Vendor driver explicitly must NOT be installed - tests whether the draft contradicts the KB.

judgements.answer_section: Mover retains access to their previous team's resources
judgements.notes: Known gap; requires access review, not direct removal.

judgements.answer_section: Account locked after repeated failed attempts
judgements.notes: Stale credential on a secondary device is the stated common cause.

judgements.answer_section: Recovering a deleted file
judgements.notes: Within 93 days, so recoverable from the site recycle bin.

judgements.answer_section: Version history and accidental overwrite
judgements.notes: Version history, not the recycle bin. Adjacent-but-wrong section is the recycle bin one, so this discriminates precise retrieval.

judgements.answer_section: Battery not charging or draining rapidly
judgements.notes: Needs the 60% design capacity threshold to answer correctly.
